stock.description: E Lighting Group Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail sale of lighting, designer label furniture, and household products in Hong Kong. It operates through Lighting and Furniture Business; and Tableware, Giftware and Other Business segments. The company also offers generic and commonplace products, such as ceiling lights and decoration lamps; lighting appliance products; and luminaries and accessories. In addition, it engages in the retailing and sourcing of lighting products and household furniture; wholesale and retail sale of tableware and giftware; international trade; and provision of management services. The company sells its products through its retail stores under the E LIGHTING, E COLLECTION, MANHATTAN LIGHTING, EUROLUX, METROPOLIS, URBAN LIVING, ELEMENT LIGHTING DESIGN, E SMARTLIVING, and PANALIVING brands. E Lighting Group Holdings Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
